quarterly_data.quarter: Nitto Denko quarterly financial report: Summary of Consolidated Financial Statements Q1 FY2026 (07-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q1 FY2026 (April-June 2026): revenue 271,672 million yen (up 10.3% YoY) and operating profit 49,210 million yen (up 15.4%); demand for materials used in data centers and semiconductors increased, supported by the expansion of the AI data center-related market, and the weaker yen added 8.7 billion yen to operating profit
quarterly_data.figure: revenue 271,672 million yen (+10.3%); operating profit 49,210 million yen (+15.4%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Nitto Denko quarterly financial report: Summary of Consolidated Financial Statements Q1 FY2026 (07-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Industrial Tape segment revenue 101,076 million yen (up 17.8%) and operating profit 16,280 million yen (up 64.9%): demand for process materials used in the production of semiconductor memories and ceramic capacitors increased against the backdrop of growing AI server demand; assembly materials for high-end smartphones grew with models adopting electric debonding tape for battery bonding

quarterly_data.quarter: Nitto Denko quarterly financial report: Summary of Consolidated Financial Statements Q1 FY2026 (07-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Optronics segment revenue 132,199 million yen (up 1.3%), operating profit 35,375 million yen (down 3.8%): demand for Circuit Integrated Suspension (CIS) used in higher-capacity hard disk drives for data centers was robust on the growing adoption of generative AI, while optical films for high-end laptops and tablets fell significantly on customers' production adjustments caused by rising memory semiconductor prices

quarterly_data.quarter: Nitto Denko quarterly financial report: Summary of Consolidated Financial Statements Q1 FY2026 (07-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Forecast raised on increased demand for materials used in data centers, semiconductors and high-end smartphones and a weaker-than-expected yen: full year ending March 31, 2027 revenue 1,110,000 million yen (from 1,065,000), operating profit 200,000 million yen (from 193,000); six months ending September 30, 2026 revenue 564,000 million yen, operating profit 108,000 million yen
quarterly_data.figure: FY revenue 1,110,000 million yen; operating profit 200,000 million yen
